mono.purpose: Coordinates, code, paths, timers. Measurement only, never costume.

dos: Do stake every model claim to a coordinate with its verification state attached.
Do keep all text pairs at 4.5:1 or better.
Do escape all model text before rendering.
donts: Don't add a chat window, kickers, section numbers, gradient text, or colored left borders.
Don't use orange as body text.
Don't invent refs, timings, or file contents.
Don't add web dependencies, hosted fonts, or CDN assets.
keyCharacteristics: Ruled and restrained: flat 1px ink borders, one soft shadow for the result sheet.
Coordinates are the interface: mono file:line callouts with margin keys.
Failure is first-class: voids and INFERRED verdicts are designed states.
narrative.overview: A measured drawing of a live analysis. The page behaves like a survey sheet where every model claim is staked to file:line coordinates. Color testifies rather than decorates; the single authored motion is an honest chainage tally.

rules.body: A color on screen must be doing a state, coordinate, or instrument job.
rules.name: The Testimony Rule

rules.body: State colors appear only on their tinted grounds, never as bare text on paper.
rules.name: The Ground Rule

rules.body: Every number a user compares sets in tabular numerals.
rules.name: The Tabular Rule
